messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning:
The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California, that close at or after 10 PM (i.e., 22). Also wants vegan restaurants in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. They didn't specify operating_hours for SF and Seattle, but we can assume default 21? But they might want same criteria? The prompt says "It should be at least 10 PM" for LA. For SF and Seattle, no mention of operating hours. We can use default 21. So we need to call function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby twice: once for Los Angeles with operating_hours=22, once for San Francisco with default, and once for Seattle with default. Actually we need three calls. The function signature expects location string and optional operating_hours. We'll call it three times.

We need to output the results. The function returns any. We need to handle errors. We'll call function via the tool.
